title: Inspecting the Geographical Representativeness of Images from Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: A crowdsourced user study where 540 participants from 27 countries rated how well text-to-image generated images of common nouns (both with and without country-specific prompts) reflected their local physical surroundings. Automated methods such as CLIP-based text-image similarity and k-nearest neighbors feature matching were also tested as proxies for measurement.

Calculating the Pearson correlation coefficient between the geographical representativeness scores of the generated images for the studied countries and their respective per-capita GDP, as well as comparing average scores between 'Rich West' countries and others.

Calculating the correlation between the geographical representativeness scores of the images and the total population size of each evaluated country to determine if models over-represent populous nations.
